title: My First Job
topic: ประสบการณ์ส่วนตัว
lines: When I got my first part-time job at a busy café, I thought it would be
easy. I was wrong. On my first morning, I dropped two cups, gave a
customer the wrong change, and forgot to write down three orders. By
noon, I was ready to quit. My manager, Ms. Dao, called me into the back
room. I expected **her** to be angry, but instead she laughed and told me
about her own first day, when she had spilled coffee on the owner.
Over the next few weeks, I learned that the job was not really about
coffee. It was about people. Regular customers liked it when I
remembered **their** names and favorite drinks. Some were rude, of course,
but most were patient if I smiled and stayed calm. **This** surprised me.
I had always been shy, but talking to strangers all day made me braver.
Now, a year later, I train new staff myself. When **they** make mistakes,
I tell them about my first morning. It always makes **them** feel better.
